title: Spain's Sanchez, Brazil's Lula lead global gathering of left-wing leaders against far-right rise
summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez and Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva are set to co-chair a gathering of left-wing leaders in Barcelona on Saturday aimed at countering the rise of the far right and strengthening democratic institutions.
